question: I help you think, learn, and remember. Who am I?
I pump blood to all parts of your body. Who am I?
I help you breathe in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide. Who am I?
I clean your blood and make urine. Who am I?
I help store and digest the food you eat. Who am I?
I help you see colors, people, and objects. Who am I?
I help you hear sounds and music. Who am I?
I help you smell flowers, food, and perfumes. Who am I?
I help you taste sweet, sour, salty, and bitter foods. Who am I?
I help you chew food before swallowing it. Who am I?
I am the largest organ in your body. I cover and protect you. Who am I?
I connect your head to your body. Who am I?
I help you pick up, carry, and throw things. Who am I?
I help you walk, run, and jump. Who am I?
I connect all parts of your body and send messages from your brain. Who am I?
